episode_title: Peak Season Planning with Caitlin Coghlan, Global Director of E-Commerce at The Cookware Company

real_qa.q: When did peak holiday shopping season shift to start in e-commerce?
real_qa.r: Holidays used to start about the first week of November when the gifting process began. At this point, it is the second week of October when you start to see that trend hit.
real_qa.requete: holiday peak season e-commerce start date

real_qa.q: What is The Cookware Company's main competitive advantage in supply chain strategy?
real_qa.r: The biggest difference is that they own their factories in China, Italy, Germany, and Korea, plus offices in Australia, India, and Canada. Having that full end-to-end ownership over the supply chain allows them to have close relationships with factories and vendors, maximize collaboration, and be transparent where not a lot of other competitors can.
real_qa.requete: Cookware Company supply chain ownership factories

real_qa.q: How much has The Cookware Company expanded its product catalog year over year?
real_qa.r: They increased their catalog by about 50% year over year, expanding into new categories such as electrics and tools. Being able to put their non-toxic coating on many new categories allowed them to expand education and customer reach.
real_qa.requete: Cookware Company product catalog growth 50 percent

real_qa.q: What inventory model did Amazon shift to and why is it challenging for suppliers?
real_qa.r: Amazon moved from a just-in-case model during quarantine where they wanted eight weeks of supply on any product, to a just-in-time model where they now only want two weeks of supply. This is tough when dealing with port delays, transportation trucking delays, and hiring challenges.
real_qa.requete: Amazon just-in-time inventory two weeks supply

real_qa.q: What is the main metric Caitlin Coghlan monitors daily to manage supply chain performance?
real_qa.r: The most important metric is weeks of supply at the vendor. She wants to make sure they are never out of stock and maintain weeks of supply cover at each retailer at any point in time, especially to support consumers who increased home cooking during the pandemic.
real_qa.requete: weeks of supply inventory metric e-commerce

real_qa.q: What harmful chemicals does The Cookware Company's nonstick coating avoid?
real_qa.r: Their patent-pending ceramic nonstick Thermalon coating does not release PTFE, PFAS, or PFOAs—harmful forever chemicals found in traditional nonstick cookware. These chemicals have been featured in documentaries and movies like Dark Waters, and regulations around them are becoming stricter, especially in California and Maine.
real_qa.requete: PTFE PFAS ceramic nonstick coating Thermalon

guest.bio_context: Caitlin began her career as a buyer for brands such as Party City, Liberty Media, and Toys R Us. She then joined Amazon as a vendor manager, managing the P&L and determining the strategic direction of the toys category. She joined The Cookware Company in 2017, where she now leads e-commerce strategy for a global cookware manufacturer with multiple brand portfolios including Green Pan, Green Life, Merton & Stork, and Blue Diamond.
